intro: Marukai is a Darkspear jungle troll stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the foggy coast of northwest Ashenvale. Dedicated to holding this remote beachhead for the Horde, she coordinates efforts to cull the encroaching Wrathtail naga who threaten the outpost.

p: Zoram'gar Outpost sits isolated on the northern edge of the Zoram Strand, surrounded by ancient ruins, hostile night elf territory, and the restless sea. As the Wrathtail naga emerge in force from the waters and ancient elven ruins to claim the shoreline, Marukai works to keep the encampment from being overwhelmed. She directs Horde champions to push the serpent-folk back into the tide and collect their heads, ensuring the outpost remains a viable coastal stronghold.
